title: Two Tellings of One Absence

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: Two gaps named in one breath become one hunger. Keep your breath for the pot, and keep the bread where it was put.
epigraph.attribution: A neighbour's saying at the loaf shelf, Low Kiln

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a one-hundred-and-one-to-one-hundred-and-three-day-old body carried everywhere; the old life colours the noticing (the exact count kept against a house that keeps it badly, the hand to the record before the hand to the person, an anatomy read perfectly and worth nothing) without a present-tense Chicago break or a \memory{} tag --- the old life stays offstage --- and there is no departure from his eyes, no Court, Waiting Room or collector interior

scenes.title: One Breath, Two Gaps
scenes.synopsis: One dated entry, Day 101, Seed 12, Secondday, morning in the Clay Yard and at the loaf shelf in the Vail kiln-house; going of the light on the bed under the roof. The boy is one hundred and one days old and his count is still the only exact arithmetic in Low Kiln; the seed stands in the barley fields, the new finer grey lies unswept beside the clean dark line, and the house goes around two empty places --- one on the shelf, one in the fold --- without naming either. A neighbour reaching past the bare board speaks of the old space at the loaf row's end as a thing the planting brought in and of the empty place at the boy's ear as a child's appetite, in one breath, without seeing that they are one absence; she gets her pot and goes. Plant T097 here: the witness who names both absences in one breath and will one day lay a finger on the shelf and call the two places an account --- plant only, no joining, no name, no payment and no third gap. The boy files the neighbour's two tellings on two places and does not let one explain the other, because he has learned what likeness laid on likeness will do to a man who wants an answer. Sella Vail says the house, gives the instruction to the pot, the fire and the broom and never to the basket, and does not hear the two places as one; she touches the widow's mark at no hour because a shelf, a strip, a basket and a bed are not openings. Tarn's knife is on its sill with six counted and the seventh nearly gone and still held; the carried fire keeps four, four and a gap with its payer unnamed for a hundred and one days; one brown-edged crust lies stiff in the fold with its empty place unnamed and no third. The body humiliates him in its known order. Advances T097 (planted), T060/T086, T071/T072 (101), T058/T079, T009/T013/T092, T088. Withheld: no joining of the two places, no cause, no third crust, no ending.

scenes.title: Two Places That Do Not Touch
scenes.synopsis: One dated entry continued, Day 101, Seed 12, Secondday, afternoon in the Vail kiln-house at the shelf and the clay jar, then dusk on the bed under the roof. The boy sets the shelf's old space and its new gap together on the shelf, and the fold's one gap beside the stiff crust in the fold, and keeps the two rooms from touching by the only instrument he has, which is attention, and it buys him nothing. He wants the number of his days said aloud by somebody who would know what it counted and gets none; the house keeps its days in loaves pushed along a shelf, glances at the clay jar and a space at the row's end nobody calls a number. The neighbour's single breath is filed as two sayings --- a planting and an appetite --- and he writes no cause across the space between them. In the afternoon a woman moving a pot lifts it a hand's breadth too high and sets it down again; it gives no note worth calling and he adds no seventh hearing. Dusk: Sella Vail carries him up at the half-pace from every open slate, sets him on his bed under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, puts the fold right without looking at his face and leaves the thread at his mouth frozen; she tells the fire it was the thaw, turns the coals with the back of a broken pot, and the fire answers four, four and a gap, its payer unnamed. The river's low note comes through the finger's-width-open door in one place and the fire's gap through the floor in another. Advances T071/T072 (101), T060/T086, T061/T082, T058/T079, T088, T009/T013. Withheld: no joining, no seventh hearing, no name for the empty places, no ending.

scenes.title: The Road He Does Not Turn Along
scenes.synopsis: One dated entry, Day 102, Seed 13, Thirdday, before first grey through midday at the Vail kiln-house bench, the Clay Yard and the yard well; dusk under the roof. Tarn takes the broom only after Sella Vail has given it its instruction and goes over the road a house sends a man down when it wants a collector, over and over, without once turning to look along it; the small knife lies on its sill with six years standing in a mark his thumb has worn almost flat and the seventh nearly gone and still held, the one entry in this house the house cannot check. To the kindling he says Six counted. The next I don't count; he says Yes, house to an early thaw and a late, agrees so entirely that no argument can find a foot, and keeps wanting the late because it puts off the paying though the paying has stood in the ruts since the water went. Ash is worked into the creases of his knuckles in the colour of the clean dark line and no scrubbing lifts it; the pale clip-ring at his left wrist holds what light there is and gives it back. He was sent once for a collector in the Long Cold, came back at the frozen ford and told the house it had been done, and keeps that sentence where he keeps the seventh year and enters neither. A loan that can hear is a loan that can be called; the sentence has never been said under this roof and lies under it all the same. At the well Berr Clay passes up the clay road with the red wool cord of his office folded under his coat and the green of tasted glaze at one corner of his mouth, wipes his thumb twice on his apron before touching nothing, reads the figure as one in twelve as the notice says and takes himself out of his own sentence with There'll be a slate at the watch; he goes off toward High Kiln with the box in his house locked and the true subtraction inside, believing he has done a kindness. A neighbour at the bucket-round alludes to a room shut in the war with the men inside dead of the breath --- a mention, not a telling --- and the yard lets it lie; the two tellings of the shut counting room stay two on their tray, joined to no kiln, likeness and difference kept, and no third telling comes. Advances T036/T076, T065/T095, T041/T047/T077, T058/T079, T071/T072 (102), T088. Withheld: no seventh year spent, no loan called, no collector, no third telling, no box opened, no ending.

scenes.title: A Mention, Not a Telling
scenes.synopsis: One dated entry continued, Day 102, Seed 13, Thirdday, afternoon at the Vail wheel-shed and its damper, in the Clay Yard and under the roof at dusk. Men have come in before first grey and spoken low in the finger's-width-open back room and Jorra Vail gives the house no name for them and does not say the room was cold; he comes through with fine grey slate dust worked into both forearms past the bend of his little finger, not the bone-coloured slip of the wheel, and the boy keeps dusty forearms and clean ones on one tray without asking which slate was broken or whether it was a birth-slate. The broken birth-slates stay under the lowest rack, gone around as wide as a pail of hot water set where a child might knock it and entered by nobody. Jorra speaks to the wheel before anyone --- it does not care whose hands, only if they are steady --- tells a pot You'll do, knows the full note of a Vail pot before it leaves the wheel and will not say so before a kiln-master from High Kiln. When Sella Vail has not finished telling him the fire is low his bent finger goes into the damper ahead of her sentence, the cold iron taking the cold out of the fingertip, so the end of her instruction arrives at the pot and the household straightens around his silence the way cloth straightens when a weight is lifted. He reads the iron as the bite that holds a vessel whole and can take the hand off a man, with no word in Grathic for both mercies, and keeps the reading to himself, exact and worth nothing. Under the roof the private file is checked and unchanged and the carried fire keeps four, four and a gap under blind ash and the back of a broken pot, its payer unnamed for a hundred and two days; the new grey stays unswept and called the thaw. Advances T035/T031, T062, T061/T082, T088, T009/T013/T092, T071/T072 (102), T058/T079. Withheld: no name for the men, no opening of the back room, no seventh hearing, no ending.

scenes.title: The Board Beside Hers
scenes.synopsis: One dated entry, Day 103, Seed 14, Fourthday, dawn market at the Fishstairs below the north bridge; a short turn three doors down in House Silt at midday; going of the light on the bed under the roof. Sella Vail sets the basket at the end of the fish-trade shade where no slate lies and gives the instruction to the wool and the water and never to the basket. Mira Silt works the eels with pale slime dried on her sleeves and silt dried pale in the hollow of her neck, her head held a little to the right where the top of her left ear had been, her small smile kept like a door on the latch; asked whether the run will be thin she answers her own answer, Thin? Who's to say thin? It comes when it comes. Ask the river, and moves eel-bones against her thumb while deciding whether to lie. When a buyer names a figure her thumb goes under her apron to the grey cord and stays, and shifting a creel shows the second cord twisted twice beneath it, never carried upriver to Nine Pots or lifted at a door, neither knot counted and the knot for the thin child upriver untouched. Her board lies beside Orra Weir's knot-string and does not touch it; Orra watches from where she watches and gets no answer. The steps come back four, four and a landing a hand's breadth out of line that a whole market walks over carefully without a fall; the soft-cuffed clerk still sits with his cuff grey from washing and his slate to his forearm for a measure nobody called, hand to slate before eyes to stalls, filed apart from Marra, the Drawing collector and the Court-table clerk, with no sixth sighting of the neat dark hand. Midday, three doors down in House Silt, Alda Reed lays her birth-slates writing-down on the bench before she turns to the fold, presses the wool a breath too long, crosses two fingers at the red edge of the birth-flower before she knows it and covers the sign with a dead woman's date; Warm and breathing, that's all I've set down, exact and not true; her hand goes once to the little tin inside her bodice without opening it, her sixth narrow slate stays face-down toward a floorboard, six pages unread, and the round pewter tin above the empty bed keeps its pale fold and thumb-bright lid shut. No seventh page is written and T023 is not paid again. Advances T059/T025/T024, T090/T080, T023/T089, T007/T008/T073, T083, T058/T079, T071/T072 (103). Withheld: no knot counted, no word forty, no tin opened, no name or number from Dessa, no sixth sighting, no ending.

scenes.title: Six Pages Shut
scenes.synopsis: One dated entry continued, Day 103, Seed 14, Fourthday, midday in House Silt and the walk back up the Clay Yard; dusk under the Vail roof. The room three doors down holds its bench, pot, draught under the door and grey ridge along the skirting as a fifth likeness of the birth room, the kiln-house, the death-house and the Court's room read as a voice through a doorway; the boy sets them in separate places and writes no cause across them. Alda Reed goes on with dates after the question has stopped, touches the tin inside her bodice without opening it, and leaves the writing face-down; the mercy-lie has curdled through to a fact in a dead woman's face nobody alive can correct, and no living person can take the date off the sign. Sella Vail sets the basket just inside the finger's-width-open door away from every open slate, opens no slate and turns no errand into a walk to Slate Row, and carries him home at the half-pace saying nothing about the writing, the tin or the fold pressed too long. Walking back the boy sets the shelf's two unnamed gaps and the fold's one gap on three places that do not touch and lets them be three absences in rooms that do not join, because a likeness laid on a likeness grows a cause unless a hand holds them apart. Down below the sill a child's foot stays dark inside its wool and a neighbour at the tubs still calls the water weather, so the cold and the weather still never meet. Dusk: Sella carries him up, sets him on his bed under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, puts the fold right without looking at his face and leaves the thread frozen; she touches the widow's mark at no hour because a door a finger's width open is not an opening. Advances T023/T089, T007/T008/T073, T060/T086, T081, T093/T094/T096, T058/T079, T071/T072 (103), T061/T082. Withheld: no tin or box opened, no recognition of the mother, no silt-leach, no cause, no ending.

scenes.title: One Hundred and Three
scenes.synopsis: One dated entry continued, Day 103, Seed 14, Fourthday, afternoon under the Vail kiln-house roof and the going of the light on the bed. The boy is one hundred and three days old and nobody has told him so; the private file is checked the way a man checks instruments laid out on a towel and is unchanged. Six hearings of the full note stay six beside and never among --- five from four sources and the sixth out of a person --- and no seventh comes. Three near-full answers stand on their tray, advanced and not paid --- a cup across a birth room, a pot under the wheel-shed wall, a rack pot in the yard --- and three intervals lie on another. The word forty is unspoken, with the readable shape of the double turn beside it, a cord twisted twice beneath another cord where no hand has counted either knot, and the weight of a thumb on wicker set apart from both; four low things keep their four places and the river's note of water going over water is a fifth thing on a place of its own and not a hearing. The two tellings of the shut counting room stay on their tray joined to no kiln, likeness and difference kept and no third; the neighbour's one-breath naming of the shelf's old space and the fold's gap is filed as two tellings on two places, T097 planted and not paid; the damper's double bite stays filed as an object, the loan that can hear stays uncalled, and the cold foot below the sill stays the cold to one woman and weather to the yard. On the loaf shelf in the next room the row keeps its two empty places and in the fold at his ear one brown-edged crust lies stiff with the empty place beside it still unnamed; no third came and no hand laid the rooms together. Every warmth has a payer and none is entered. Sella tells the fire it was the thaw, turns the coals with the back of a broken pot and feeds it; the fire answers with four low pulls and the silence where the fifth should have been, its payer unnamed for a hundred and three days. The door stands a finger's width open: the river's low muttered note from the Ilm comes through the gap, nearer at the going of the water than at its coming, and the carried fire's four, four and a gap comes through the floor under blind ash and the back of a broken pot, the two sounds in two separate places as for a hundred and three days. The boards overhead keep four nails and four and a fifth that is a knot the width of a thumb, and the two counts do not meet. He is the only adult in the room and the least use in it; his hand outside the wool goes up an inch toward the note of water going over water and comes down. The count stands at one hundred and three, unspent; nothing joined, paid, explained or ended. Advances T071/T072 (103), T060/T086, T097 (planted), T061/T082, T088, T058/T079, T009/T013/T092, T093/T094/T096. Withheld: no seventh hearing, no third crust, no joining or naming of the two absences, no payment, no ending.
